ei.lesson: 어법 — TV 속 친밀도와 감정 강도 조절

fullPassage: Changes in the degree of closeness are quite important in managing emotional intensity. Take, for example, emotions induced by television. Closeness and familiarity are important in making the fictional environment more real. Accordingly, most TV shows are set in the present or in a time within the memory of the viewers. Most characters are supposed to be types with whom we are familiar. Such closeness and familiarity make it easier for us to perceive the imaginary story to be a real one. In other circumstances, such as when violence is shown on TV, the closeness variable is used to reduce emotional intensity. Television entertainment tends to place social problems involving violence in another time and place, letting us watch those fictionalized characters search for solutions to our problems in settings safely distanced from our own. When violence occurs in a contemporary setting, it is generally the product of the interaction of police and criminals — again, it is removed from the lives of good citizenry.

questions.passage: Changes in the degree of closeness ①<u>is</u> quite important in managing emotional intensity. Take, for example, emotions ②<u>induced</u> by television. In other circumstances, such as when violence is shown on TV, the closeness variable is used to reduce emotional intensity. Television entertainment tends to place social problems involving violence in another time and place, letting us watch those fictionalized characters search for solutions to our problems in settings safely ④<u>distanced</u> from our own. When violence occurs in a contemporary setting, it is generally the product of the interaction of police and criminals — again, it is removed from the lives of good citizenry.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①is(are→is, 복수 주어에 단수 동사 오류) ②induced(과거분사) ③easier(형용사 비교급) ④distanced(과거분사)
det.analysis:
① is: Closeness and familiarity are important에서 주어가 A and B로 복수이므로 are가 올바름. is는 수일치 오류 ←정답

② induced: emotions induced by television에서 과거분사가 명사를 후치수식 — 어법상 적절

③ easier: make it easier for us에서 make+목적어+형용사 보어 구문의 비교급 — 어법상 적절

④ distanced: settings safely distanced from에서 수동의 과거분사 — 어법상 적절
det.tip: A and B + are (복수 동사). Closeness and familiarity는 두 명사가 and로 연결된 복수 주어.

questions.passage: Changes in the degree of closeness are quite important in ①<u>managing</u> emotional intensity. Take, for example, emotions induced by television. Closeness and familiarity are important in making the fictional environment more real. Accordingly, most TV shows are set in the present or in a time within the memory of the viewers. Most characters are ②<u>supposed</u> to be types with ③<u>which</u> we are familiar. Such closeness and familiarity make it easier for us to perceive the imaginary story to be a real one. In other circumstances, such as when violence is shown on TV, the closeness variable is used to reduce emotional intensity. Television entertainment tends to place social problems ④<u>involving</u> violence in another time and place, letting us watch those fictionalized characters search for solutions to our problems in settings safely distanced from our own. When violence occurs in a contemporary setting, it is generally the product of the interaction of police and criminals — again, it is removed from the lives of good citizenry.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①managing(동명사) ②supposed(수동태) ③which(whom→which, 사람 선행사에 사물 관계대명사 오류) ④involving(현재분사)
det.analysis:
① managing: in managing emotional intensity에서 전치사 in의 목적어 동명사 — 어법상 적절

② supposed: are supposed to be에서 be supposed to 수동태 구문 — 어법상 적절

③ which: types with whom we are familiar에서 선행사 types는 사람 유형을 의미하며 전치사 with의 목적어 관계대명사는 whom이 적절. 사물 관계대명사 which는 오류 ←정답

④ involving: social problems involving violence에서 능동 현재분사로 후치수식 — 어법상 적절
det.tip: 전치사 + 관계대명사: 선행사가 사람이면 whom, 사물이면 which. types(사람 유형) + with whom.

questions.passage: Changes in the degree of closeness are ①<u>quite</u> important in managing emotional intensity. Take, for example, emotions induced by television. Closeness and familiarity are important in making the fictional environment more real. Accordingly, most TV shows are set in the present or in a time within the memory of the viewers. Most characters are supposed to be types with whom we are familiar. Such closeness and familiarity make it easier for us to perceive the imaginary story to be a real one. In other circumstances, such as when violence is ②<u>shown</u> on TV, the closeness variable is used to reduce emotional intensity. Television entertainment tends to ③<u>place</u> social problems involving violence in another time and place, ④<u>let</u> us watch those fictionalized characters search for solutions to our problems in settings safely distanced from our own. When violence occurs in a contemporary setting, it is generally the product of the interaction of police and criminals — again, it is removed from the lives of good citizenry.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①quite(부사) ②shown(수동태) ③place(동사원형) ④let(letting→let, 분사구문에서 현재분사 필요)
det.analysis:
① quite: quite important에서 형용사를 수식하는 부사 — 어법상 적절

② shown: when violence is shown on TV에서 수동태(be + p.p.) — 어법상 적절

③ place: tends to place에서 to부정사 뒤 동사원형 — 어법상 적절

④ let: ...in another time and place, letting us watch에서 분사구문으로 현재분사 letting이 필요. 동사원형 let은 분사구문 불가 ←정답
det.tip: 분사구문은 동사원형이 아닌 현재분사(-ing)로 시작. 주절과 동시 동작을 나타내는 부대상황의 분사구문.

questions.passage: Changes in the degree of closeness are quite important in managing emotional intensity. Take, for example, emotions induced by television. Closeness and familiarity are important in making the ①<u>genuine</u> environment more real. Accordingly, most TV shows are set in the present or in a time within the memory of the viewers. Most characters are supposed to be types with whom we are familiar. Such closeness and familiarity make it easier for us to ②<u>perceive</u> the imaginary story to be a real one. In other circumstances, such as when violence is shown on TV, the closeness variable is used to ③<u>reduce</u> emotional intensity. Television entertainment tends to place social problems involving violence in another time and place, letting us watch those fictionalized characters search for solutions to our problems in settings safely distanced from our own. When violence occurs in a ④<u>contemporary</u> setting, it is generally the product of the interaction of police and criminals — again, it is removed from the lives of good citizenry.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①genuine(진짜의→원문: fictional 허구의) ②perceive(인식하다) ③reduce(줄이다) ④contemporary(동시대의)
det.analysis:
① genuine: 진짜의 → 원문은 fictional(허구의). 친밀감이 '진짜 환경'을 더 실제처럼 만든다고 하면 이미 실제인 것을 실제처럼 만든다는 동어반복 ←정답

② perceive: 가상의 이야기를 실제라고 인식하다 — 문맥상 적절

③ reduce: 감정 강도를 줄이다 — 문맥상 적절

④ contemporary: 동시대적 배경 — 문맥상 적절
det.tip: making the fictional environment more real — 허구의 환경을 더 실제처럼. genuine(진짜의)으로 바꾸면 의미 모순.

questions.passage: Changes in the degree of ①<u>closeness</u> are quite important in managing emotional intensity. Take, for example, emotions induced by television. Closeness and familiarity are important in making the fictional environment more real. Accordingly, most TV shows are set in the present or in a time within the memory of the viewers. Most characters are supposed to be types with whom we are familiar. Such closeness and familiarity make it ②<u>easier</u> for us to perceive the imaginary story to be a real one. In other circumstances, such as when violence is shown on TV, the closeness variable is used to reduce emotional intensity. Television entertainment tends to place social problems involving violence in another time and place, letting us watch those ③<u>authenticated</u> characters search for solutions to our problems in settings safely distanced from our own. When violence occurs in a contemporary setting, it is generally the product of the ④<u>interaction</u> of police and criminals — again, it is removed from the lives of good citizenry.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①closeness(친밀감) ②easier(더 쉬운) ③authenticated(인증된→원문: fictionalized 허구화된) ④interaction(상호작용)
det.analysis:
① closeness: 친밀감의 정도 변화 — 문맥상 적절

② easier: 더 쉽게 인식하게 만든다 — 문맥상 적절

③ authenticated: 인증된 → 원문은 fictionalized(허구화된). TV 오락이 허구화된 캐릭터가 문제 해결을 하게 한다는 맥락에서 authenticated(인증된)로 바꾸면 거리두기 논지와 반대 ←정답

④ interaction: 경찰과 범죄자의 상호작용 — 문맥상 적절
det.tip: those fictionalized characters — 허구화된 등장인물. authenticated(인증된)로 바꾸면 거리두기 전략과 모순.

det.korean: 친밀감의 정도 변화는 감정 강도를 ___하는 데 아주 중요하다.
det.analysis:
① manage emotional intensity (감정 강도를 관리하다): 글 전체의 핵심 주제와 일치 ←정답

② increase audience ratings (시청률을 높이다): 시청률에 대한 언급 없음

③ promote violent content (폭력적 콘텐츠를 홍보하다): 오히려 폭력의 감정 강도를 줄인다는 맥락

④ eliminate fictional elements (허구적 요소를 제거하다): 허구적 환경을 더 실제처럼 만든다는 맥락과 반대
det.tip: Changes in the degree of closeness are quite important in managing emotional intensity — 글의 주제문.

det.korean: 대부분의 TV 쇼는 ___에 설정된다.
det.analysis:
① the present or in a time within the memory (현재 또는 기억 범위 안의 시간대): 원문과 일치. 시청자에게 친숙한 시간대를 배경으로 함 ←정답

② the distant past beyond human recollection (인간 기억 너머의 먼 과거): 친숙함의 맥락과 정반대

③ a mythical era of heroic adventures (영웅 모험의 신화 시대): 친숙함 논의와 무관

④ an alternate dimension of pure fantasy (순수 판타지의 대체 차원): 현실감을 높이는 전략과 모순
det.tip: most TV shows are set in the present or in a time within the memory of the viewers — 시청자에게 친숙한 시간대.

ch: the present or in a time within the memory
the distant past beyond human recollection
a mythical era of heroic adventures
an alternate dimension of pure fantasy

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ③ TV 오락이 폭력 관련 사회 문제를 다른 시공간에 배치한다는 내용은 본문과 일치한다.
det.analysis:
① 감정 반응을 강화 (강화): 본문은 reduce emotional intensity(줄이다)이므로 불일치

② 낯선 유형 (낯선): 본문은 types with whom we are familiar(친숙한 유형)이므로 불일치

③ 다른 시공간에 배치 (배치): place social problems involving violence in another time and place — 일치 ←정답

④ 선량한 시민 일상에서 발생 (일상): 본문은 removed from the lives of good citizenry(제거)이므로 불일치
det.tip: place social problems involving violence in another time and place — 다른 시공간에 배치. 거리두기 전략.

ch: TV에서 폭력 등장 시 친밀감 변수는 감정 반응을 강화한다.
TV 쇼 등장인물은 시청자에게 낯선 유형으로 설정된다.
TV 오락은 폭력 사회문제를 다른 시공간에 배치한다.
동시대 폭력은 선량한 시민의 일상에서 발생한다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ② 본문은 '다른 시간과 장소'에 배치한다고 했으므로 '시청자 가까이'는 불일치.
det.analysis:

ch: 친밀감의 정도 변화는 감정 강도 관리에 상당히 중요하다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: TV에서 친밀감이 감정 강도를 조절하는 데 활용되는 방식이 글의 주제이다.
det.analysis:
① TV 폭력의 부정적 영향 (부정적 영향): 부정적 영향이 아닌 감정 강도 '조절 기제'를 다룸

② 친밀감이 감정 강도 조절에 활용되는 방식 (조절 방식): 글 전체의 핵심 주제 — 친밀감을 높이거나 낮춰 감정 강도를 관리 ←정답

③ TV 프로그래밍 장르의 역사 (역사): 장르 역사에 대한 내용 없음
